narration:0:1510728001:0.text: Nazrik throws his spear, which embeds itself firmly into the cliff wall on the other side of the rift.
narration:0:1510728001:0.source_cn: 那非扔出的矛牢牢钉进了深壑另一侧的崖壁

narration:1:1510728002:0.text: After wrapping your hands in thick cloth, the three of you grab the rope and begin to slide across the rift.
narration:1:1510728002:0.source_cn: 用布缠住手掌后，你们三人抓紧绳索，向着深壑对岸滑去
